source_text: Amen dico tibi, priusquam gallus cantet, ter me negabis. Quaeritur utrum si deprecatus fuisset ut repelleretur praecognita denegatio, forsitan non denegasset — sicut Ninivitis exoratus quae per Jonam praedixerat non fecit. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Amen I-say to-you, before rooster may-crow, thrice me you-will-deny. It-is-asked whether if he-had-begged that be-repelled the foreknown denial, perhaps not he-would-have-denied — just-as to-Ninevites having-been-entreated the-things which through Jonah he-had-foretold he-did-not. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Amen I say to you, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times >> Bible:Matthew 26:34]]. One asks whether, if he had begged that the foreknown denial be turned aside, he might not have denied — as when God, entreated by the Ninevites, did not do what he had announced through Jonah. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
